_comment: Single source for the default models. ai-provider.ts imports it and scripts/check-ai.mjs reads it, so the diagnostic can never report on a model the app does not use. Verified against the live catalogues on 2026-10-08: inclusionai/ling-3.0-flash-fin stopped being free (404), and dots-3 answered in ~12 s with mangled tool names, which is what made the copilot slow and confused whenever Groq saturated. Nemotron 3 Super called both test tools correctly in 2.6-3.4 s. OpenRouter does fall through the models array on 404 and 429 (measured), unlike on 402. OpenRouter accepts at most three models per request, so the list is the primary plus two - picked from different vendors, since two models from one vendor saturate together. Override per environment with GROQ_MODEL / OPENROUTER_MODEL.
_comment_paid: Every model here is :free on purpose. To move to a paid one - x-ai/grok-4.7 is the intended upgrade, USD 1.60/M in and 4.80/M out, and it fixes the copilot falling back to keyword mode when the Groq free tier saturates - the OpenRouter account must have purchased credits first. TRAP, measured on 2026-09-28: an account with no credits answers 402, and a 402 does NOT fall through to the rest of the models array - the whole request fails, taking the free models down with it. So naming a paid model here before the credits exist breaks the fallback chain entirely rather than degrading it.
